tools.description: Link a project to a board, task, repo, doc, decision, metric, or agent. For connected sessions, a REPO link uses the normalized lowercase "owner/name" as targetId (a GitHub URL is accepted and normalized) — the link that satisfies the session repo gate. Adding an edge that already exists is a no-op. Needs the workspace ADMIN role.

metadata.description: Per-link attributes (e.g. agent role, repo allowed-paths).

targetId.description: ID or URL of the linked entity (board/task id, repo, doc URL…).

tools.name: add_project_link

tools.description: Link two tasks of ANY board kind in the same workspace (cross-board allowed), e.g. a bug that BLOCKS a deal. Kinds: BLOCKS, DEPENDS_ON, RELATES_TO, DUPLICATES. Rejects BLOCKS/DEPENDS_ON edges that would create a cycle — the error names the cycle path by task key. Adding an edge that already exists is a no-op.

fromTaskId.description: Task ID on the FROM side of the edge (any board kind).

kind.description: Edge kind: BLOCKS (from blocks to), DEPENDS_ON (from depends on to), RELATES_TO (bidirectional marker), or DUPLICATES (from duplicates to). Only BLOCKS/DEPENDS_ON participate in cycle detection.

toTaskId.description: Task ID on the TO side of the edge (any board kind, same workspace).

tools.name: add_task_link

tools.description: Jentrix MVP: anchor an OPEN session to a work item + accountable owner after the operator confirmed the wizard's choices. The server builds the alignment snapshot (ids + display names), stores it on the session, and returns it — echo it VERBATIM to the operator. Re-aligning replaces the anchor and writes a visible activity row, never silently. The session's project/workspace are immutable — a different project means a new session. Requires expectedUpdatedAt (CAS). taskId null = "no task — session-level work".

agentEmoji.description: Optional emoji rendered before the producer label.

agentLabel.description: Optional producer label for this session ("triage-bot"). Null = the operator themself; absent leaves it unchanged.

capture.description: TRACE capture mode for this session. OMIT to let the server resolve it: this session's previous value, then the operator's account default (Account → Capture), then the built-in off.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: REQUIRED optimistic concurrency guard: the session's updatedAt from your last read; a mismatch fails with CONFLICT embedding the current state.

ownerUserId.description: Accountable human owner (workspace member); defaults to the session operator.

skeleton.description: Activity-skeleton mode for this session, independent of capture. OMIT to let the server resolve it: this session's previous value, then the operator's account default, then the built-in on.

taskId.description: The aligned work item. Null/absent = "no task — session-level work".

tokenBudget.description: Optional token budget for this session. Crossing it records an activity row and badges the card; it never stops the session.

tools.name: align_agent_session

tools.description: Archive a board (admin scope + board ADMIN) — the inverse of unarchive_boards. Soft delete: the board and its tasks are retained and unarchive_boards reverses it.

taskId.description: ID of the task to archive (soft delete).

tools.description: Bind a TRUSTED current provider session/thread id (from provider lifecycle hooks or app-server context — never model-authored text) to a Jentrix session. With sessionId: late-binds a CLI-started session's provider thread (CAS). Without: attach-creates an ACTIVE session — v2 shape scopes by workspaceId (no Project), legacy shape by projectId for the compatibility window; repeating converges on the existing session by operator + workspace + repo (row creation runs the plan cap; convergence does not). A competing active binding fails SESSION_ALREADY_BOUND. Requires idempotencyKey.

idempotencyKey.description: REQUIRED launch nonce: retrying with the same key and arguments returns the original result instead of creating a second session.

importHistory.description: Operator chose to import prior VISIBLE provider history through a supported provider surface.

projectId.description: LEGACY attach-create shape (compatibility window); the server derives the workspace from the project.

providerSessionId.description: The current provider session/thread id from TRUSTED provider lifecycle context (hooks/app-server) — never model-authored text.

sessionId.description: Existing STARTING/ACTIVE session to bind the provider thread to (CLI-start late binding). Omit to attach-create in one step.

workspaceId.description: The session's workspace (v2 attach-create shape). No Project is required.

tools.name: attach_agent_session

tools.description: Attach a first-class artifact (PR/diff/log/screenshot/eval report/run summary/…) linked to a task/project/run/decision/Work Order. EXTERNAL_URL storage takes a url; R2_OBJECT storage requires an uploadGrantId from POST /api/artifacts/upload-grant (REST, same bearer) after PUTting the bytes to its presigned uploadUrl — `jentrix artifact upload <file>` runs that whole flow. Returns the stored artifact record.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key: retrying with the same key and arguments within 24h returns the original result instead of creating duplicates. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with CONFLICT.

sessionId.description: Connected session that produced this artifact (must belong to the same workspace). Optional: the request's own validated session correlation is used when omitted.

uploadGrantId.description: Server-issued upload grant (POST /api/artifacts/upload-grant) bound to workspace, exact object key, checksum, MIME type, size, and expiry. Required when storage is R2_OBJECT; consumed once.

tools.description: Close a session with an honest lifecycle outcome (COMPLETED normal end / INTERRUPTED crash / CANCELLED pre-first-turn abort). The server verifies the trace-part manifest against durable artifacts, stores the deterministic RUN_SUMMARY, and sets captureComplete ONLY when every expected part and the summary are acknowledged — lifecycle and capture integrity stay orthogonal. Requires expectedUpdatedAt (CAS).

acknowledgeEvidenceGaps.description: Close even with unmet evidence-floor checks (E1–E3); each unmet check is stamped MISSING into the summary's Review readiness.

commitCount.description: CLI-counted commits in startHead..endHead; absent = not counted (HEAD movement is then the only signal).

expectedUpdatedAt.description: REQUIRED optimistic concurrency guard: the session's updatedAt from your last read; a mismatch fails with CONFLICT embedding the current state.

manifest.description: Expected TRACE parts; capture is complete only when every part is acknowledged server-side.

outcome.description: Lifecycle outcome: COMPLETED for a normal provider end, INTERRUPTED for a detected crash, CANCELLED for a pre-first-turn abort. Capture integrity is orthogonal and server-computed.

usage.description: Provider-RECEIPT token rollups and measured timing only — never estimated. Wall time is server-derived.

missingRanges.description: Named missing receipt/interval ranges when coverage is PARTIAL.

perModel.description: Cumulative per-model receipt rollups; the heartbeat attributes per-model deltas to the open alignment interval.

modelId.description: Null = receipts whose model was never observed.

tools.description: Rename a workspace and/or set its connected-session default repository (admin scope + ADMIN role). `defaultRepo` takes a normalized "owner/name" (lowercased at the write boundary; null clears it) — sessions fall back to it only when no project in the workspace carries an explicit REPO link. `slug` and `taskPrefix` are WRITE-ONCE — passing either is refused with INVALID_INPUT. Rename concurrency is VALUE-CAS, not timestamp CAS: pass `expectedName` (the name you last read); `expectedUpdatedAt` is refused (workspaces carry no updatedAt — M19.2). A value-CAS mismatch returns CONFLICT embedding the current state under error.current.

defaultRepo.description: Workspace-level default repository for connected sessions, as "owner/name" (normalized to lowercase at the write boundary; null clears it). The session repo gate falls back to it ONLY when no project in the workspace carries an explicit REPO link.

expectedName.description: Value-CAS guard: the workspace name you last read. If it changed since, the call fails with CONFLICT.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: NOT USED on this plane and REFUSED with INVALID_INPUT. Workspaces and memberships carry no updatedAt (M19.2), so concurrency here is VALUE-CAS: pass expectedName (workspace) / expectedRole (membership) instead.

slug.description: WRITE-ONCE and REFUSED with INVALID_INPUT: a workspace slug is derived from its name at creation and never changes.

taskPrefix.description: WRITE-ONCE and REFUSED with INVALID_INPUT: the task-key prefix is derived from the slug at creation and never changes.
